description: Export a Cloud DB for MySQL server log file to Object Storage. Use ncloud_list_mysql_logs to get available log files.

bucketName.description: Object Storage bucket name to export to

folderPath.description: Folder path within the bucket (e.g. 'mysql-logs/error'). If omitted, exports to bucket root.

logType.description: Log type to export: BINARY (binlog), ERROR (error log), SLOW (slow query log), GENERAL (general log), AUDIT (audit log)

name: ncloud_export_mysql_log
